Configuration for the [OpusDNS](https://www.opusdns.com) DNS provider.

See the [lego documentation](https://go-acme.github.io/lego/dns/opusdns/) for full details.

```yaml
letsEncrypt:
  dnsProvider: "opusdns"
  dnsCredentials:
    # OPUSDNS_API_KEY: API key (format: opk_...)
    apiKey: ""
    # OPUSDNS_POLLING_INTERVAL: Time between DNS propagation check in seconds (Default: 4)
    pollingInterval: ""
    # OPUSDNS_PROPAGATION_TIMEOUT: Maximum waiting time for DNS propagation in seconds (Default: 120)
    propagationTimeout: ""
    # OPUSDNS_TTL: The TTL of the TXT record used for the DNS challenge in seconds (Default: 60)
    ttl: ""
```

Credentials are passed directly to lego using strong types and are never written to the process environment.
You may also use the raw lego environment-variable names as keys instead of the normalized names.
